entities.summary: Ronald Ellis Tutt was an American drummer who was the principal drummer for Elvis Presley, Neil Diamond, the Carpenters, Roy Orbison,, and Jerry Garcia. He was also a session drummer who recorded with some of the most prominent musicians of his day.
